blocks.text: Have you ever wondered why buying a TV on hire purchase costs more than paying cash upfront?

blocks.markdown: Hire purchase is a method of buying goods through an initial deposit followed by regular instalments. This allows you to use the item while paying for it over time.

blocks.title: Hire Purchase
blocks.text: Hire purchase is a system where a buyer pays for goods in parts or a percentage at a time. The buyer gains ownership of the item after the final instalment is paid.

blocks.markdown: In hire purchase, the total cost is usually higher than the cash price due to interest. The hire purchase price is the sum of the deposit and all instalments.

blocks.title: Calculating Hire Purchase Price
blocks.prompt: A refrigerator costs ₦120,000 cash. On hire purchase, a deposit of ₦30,000 is required, followed by 12 monthly instalments of ₦8,000 each. What is the hire purchase price?

steps.text: Add the deposit to the total instalments: \(30,000 + 96,000 = 126,000\).

blocks.markdown: The extra cost of buying on hire purchase is the difference between the hire purchase price and the cash price.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Always check if the question requires you to find the hire purchase price or the extra cost. They are related but different calculations.

points: Hire purchase involves a deposit and regular instalments.
The hire purchase price is usually higher than the cash price due to interest.
